entities.name: Thriss
entities.description: Primus Thriss, powerful giant mantis-like Nantuko druid and guardian of the Krosan Forest who trained Kamahl as a druid.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: Barbarian whom Thriss convinced to abandon his barbarous ways and trained as a druid.

entities.name: Krosan Forest
entities.description: Forest on Dominaria guarded by Thriss.

entities.name: Nantuko
entities.description: Mantis-like druid people; Thriss was the oldest and wisest.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion of Dominaria during which Thriss kept the forest safe.

entities.name: Mirari Saga
entities.description: Story period during which Thriss was the oldest and wisest Nantuko.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: Artifact whose transformative powers Kamahl speculated mutated Krosa and Thriss.

events.summary: Thriss plants the seeds that become the Krosan forest after the Ice Age recedes.
events.quote: Thriss planted the seeds that became the Krosan forest after the Ice Age receded

events.summary: Thriss guards the forest and keeps it safe during the Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: He guarded the forest and kept it safe during the Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria

events.summary: Thriss convinces Kamahl to abandon his barbarous ways and trains him as a druid.
events.quote: He convinced Kamahl to abandon his barbarous ways and trained him as a druid.

events.summary: Thriss's fate is unknown; Kamahl speculates he mutated with Krosa due to the Mirari.

relations.note: Thriss trained Kamahl as a druid.
relations.quote: He convinced Kamahl to abandon his barbarous ways and trained him as a druid.

relations.note: He is guardian of the forest.
relations.quote: became guardian of the Krosan Forest on Dominaria
